launch_deduplication.scope: Byte-identical receipt deduplication only; no currency or complete paid-call totals inferred

runtime_ownership.evidence_scope: Same-session native read-only task/process inventory plus source commitments; readable process scope does not exclude inaccessible elevated processes.

legacy_hyperv_task.responsibility: Hyper-V quarantine-VM health and escalation; separate from the 4.2.7 pipeline controller and modern supervisor.
legacy_hyperv_task.preservation: Preserve independently. Do not stop, disable or pass as modern controller Warden merely by its name.

legacy_live_ingress.responsibility: Existing MCP ingress with job-board write capability; worker interlock does not quiesce this process.

runtime_ownership.controller_liveness: Not established by these MCP process names. No protected SYSTEM controller acceptance inferred.

sre_interlock.preservation: Preserve existing value. Legacy start_pipeline and watchdog exit when set to 1.

start_pipeline_definition.v412_and_v420: Starts old Warden MCP48821, DSP toolkit48822, knowledge48823, DSP worker and watchdog if interlock permits; v420 additionally starts Oracle. Source definition, not proof these processes are running.

legacy_oracle_definition.liveness: No matching process observed in readable scope.

unassigned_separate_database.reason: Different schema and 24 pending jobs; no authoritative live writer identified. Preserve separately, do not merge with root job_board.db.

modern_migrator.compatibility: None of the inspected legacy databases supplies these schemas. Missing named files must not be interpreted as no historical repairs. NO_PRIOR_LEDGER is not a legacy conversion.

authority.jobs: Keep each root/db path and source identity separate; recorded RUNNING is not liveness. Legacy jobs do not contain modern captured Chapter06 model/effort/routing commitments.
authority.watchdog: Preserve state, cooldown/last-trigger values and all receipts. Duplicate receipts and malformed files prevent a complete authoritative paid-call reconstruction.
authority.repair_loops: Preserve per-target rounds/status and MAX_ROUNDS policy; these are historical loop counters, not exact modern supervisor or component reservations.
authority.vm_telemetry: Legacy Hyper-V tier/action records are independent from model spend.
authority.upload_quota: quota_state is youtube upload quota, not a model-repair budget.
authority.knowledge: Both root indexes reference 83 v4.1.2 wiki files and 3 user Antigravity files; preserve original source roots. The 11-document public export is not a replacement.
authority.current_pointer_and_quarantine: Modern filenames are absent at inspected roots only; no host-wide absence or fresh budget inferred.

required_implementation_or_policy: Bind immutable, private legacy snapshots and provenance to any migration receipt before activation. Existing modern ledger copier cannot provide this conversion.

Keep repair reservations held while historical budget authority is unknown. Do not reset counters or manufacture equivalent incident/day balances from receipt counts. A reviewed conservative carry-forward/import policy is needed if no authoritative modern ledger is found.

Keep historical job records immutable and held. Define explicit old-job continuation/import mapping; new admissions must capture Chapter06 routing, catalogue/scoring versions and current native contracts before reservation.
Preserve independent VM Warden ownership and ingress endpoints. Quiesce only identified writers when a consistent cutover is scheduled; do not kill unrelated MCP or legacy VM supervision.
Reconcile knowledge source path ownership and retained captures before protected indexing. Do not overwrite either existing knowledge database.

online_snapshot_proposal.method: SQLite backup API from read-only source connections to newly created private destinations, integrity-check each snapshot, hash closed outputs. Do not raw-copy a live database without its WAL. Each database backup is individually consistent; coordinated writer quiescence or explicit independent-snapshot scope is required for cross-file consistency.
online_snapshot_proposal.sensitive_snapshot_handling: Raw jobs, knowledge and bundles remain private and must not be committed to repository evidence. Copying credentials is outside this proposal. Preserve existing originals, tasks, interlock and RAM disk.

migration_assessment.manual_decision_scope: Do not ask for arbitrary database paths: seven identified files are listed. Remaining uncertainty is authority/continuation policy, not permission to discard history or treat absent ledgers as zero.
